descriptionMarkdown:
Designed for serious off-grid missions, the Outerworld Voyager v3.0 is your go-to for long hauls beyond the solar system’s edge. Fully automated and self-managed, it’s built to handle everything from asteroid harvesting to shattered planet rendezvous without needing a single poke from command.

Pre-programmed for round trips between Aquillo and Nauvis, this sleek beast knows exactly where to go, what to grab, and when to come home — all while you sip tea and admire your logistics empire from orbit
title: Outerworld Voyager v3.0 (For flights beyond the Solar System edge)
